description: Found 2026-10-07 while fixing GitHub issue #1 part 1. Codex 0.160 runs every session's commands and hooks in one shared `codex app-server --managed-daemon` with the first session's MUSTER_PANE (docs/observations/codex-0.160.0.md). Reports through it are now refused with the cause and the fix, but `muster msg` verbs are not: the daemon does not look at who sent a msg request, so a post or read from pane B's Codex acts as pane A (the issue's "@human is not in <live-pane>+<group>"). The report attribution walk (crates/muster-daemon/src/attribution.rs, which now stops at a manifest's [server]) could be reused for msg requests. `muster harness install codex` now turns daemon_auto_start off, so this bites only Codex installs set up another way.
title: 📨 muster msg run under Codex's shared app-server acts as the first session's pane
